# Disable OOS Beta Watermark

A KernelSU / Magisk / APatch module that removes the diagonal beta-build
watermark that OxygenOS / ColorOS paints over the screen.

The watermark only shows while the screen is on (it's gone in AOD and when the
display is off) because it's drawn by `WindowManagerService` as a display
overlay, not by an app. This module turns it off at the source.

## How it works

On OPlus betas the watermark is created in `system_server` by
`WindowManagerServiceExtImpl` / `WatermarkExtImpl`, which adds the
`WatermarkSurface` overlay layer for any display in state `ON`. Whether it gets
added is gated by a single read-only property:

```
ro.oplus.watermark.betaversiononly.enable=true
```

Setting it to `false` before `system_server` starts means the overlay is never
created. The module does that from `post-fs-data.sh` (which runs before zygote)
using a bundled `resetprop-rs`:

```sh
resetprop-rs --init ro.oplus.watermark.betaversiononly.enable false
```

`-p`/persist alone is not enough: that only restores `persist.*` props from
`/data/property` on boot. `ro.*` props are re-seeded from `build.prop` every
boot, so the value has to be re-applied on each boot — hence the boot script.
A `system.prop` with the same line is also included as a fallback.

## Install

1. Flash `oos-beta-watermark-disabler-vX.Y.Z.zip` in the KernelSU, Magisk, or
   APatch manager.
2. Reboot.

Requirements: arm64, root via KernelSU / Magisk / APatch, and a build that
actually ships the watermark prop (OnePlus / OPPO / realme betas).

## Uninstall

Remove the module in your manager (or `touch
/data/adb/modules/disable_oos_beta_watermark/remove`) and reboot.

## Verify

```sh
adb shell 'dumpsys SurfaceFlinger --list | grep -ci watermark'   # 0 = gone
adb shell getprop ro.oplus.watermark.betaversiononly.enable      # false
```

## Build

```sh
./build.sh        # writes dist/oos-beta-watermark-disabler-<ver>.zip
```

## Tested on

OnePlus 15 (CPH2747), OxygenOS 17 Beta, KernelSU Next. Should work on other
OPlus betas that use the same property; open an issue if yours differs.

## Credits

Property writes use [resetprop-rs](https://github.com/Enginex0/resetprop-rs)
by Enginex0 (MIT). The bundled binary is unmodified; see `module/NOTICE`.
